SUN AUG 23, 4:05 AM PT RUN.

URGENT, DAY 16 -- FOOD SAFETY ALLEGATION STILL LIVE ON GOOGLE. Donald Clay, 1 star, on The Brewhouse listing: 'Beer was not good at all. Got botulism from taco. Recovering now. Avoid this place.' Lunch, $20-30 band. This has now been flagged on three consecutive runs and is still unanswered on a 527-review public profile. Two things today, in order: pull the Aug 7 lunch prep, hold and cooling logs for the taco station BEFORE anyone types a word, then post a short non-defensive reply that moves the conversation offline. A drafted reply is staged in reviews.unanswered[]. Do not argue the medical claim in public and do not delete anything.

TOAST -- Saturday Aug 22 is PENDING; neither email had arrived by 4:05 AM. FRIDAY AUG 21 IS NOW COMPLETE: the single-location detail landed 7:39 AM Saturday and every field is populated. Net $7,160.85, gross $7,447.45, discounts $286.60 (3.8% of gross), 295 guests, 199 orders, 209 checks, avg/guest $24.27, avg order $35.98, avg check $34.26. Versus Friday Aug 14 (net $6,508.40, 255 guests, 155 orders, avg check $39.93): net +10.0%, gross +9.9%, guests +15.7%, orders +28.4%, avg check -14.2%. Versus the 4-Friday average ($7,870.50 net, 311 guests, avg check $37.66): net -9.0%, guests -5.1%, avg check -9.0%. Read it plainly: Friday beat the comparable Friday on volume and lost on spend. Orders +28.4% against net +10.0% is the entire story, and it still landed 9% under a normal Friday.

TOAST COST FLAGS, BOTH NEW WITH THE BACKFILL -- (1) VOIDS $203.25 on 17 items across 12 orders. That is +164.0% vs SDLW ($77.00) and +62.6% vs the 4-week average ($125.00), the largest single variance anywhere on the report. Twelve separate tickets means it is not one bad order; pull the void detail by employee before the weekend closes out. (2) HOURLY LABOR 22.8% of net, $1,635.92, against 18.7% / $1,214.61 SDLW and 17.3% / $1,358.14 on the 4-week. Labor cost rose 34.7% to buy a 10.0% net gain. Refunds $0.00 and deferred sales $0.00, both clean.

TOAST MIX -- Dinner $4,751.20 net (66.3%, $40.26/order), Lunch $2,113.15 (29.5%, $39.13/order), Expresso Service $296.50 (4.1%, $9.88/order). By room: Dining Room $4,055.15 (56.6%), Patio $1,398.70 (19.5%, $66.60/order), Front Patio $1,346.00 (18.7%, $61.18/order), Espresso Bar $298.00 (4.1%), Back Room $63.00. The two patios together are $2,744.70 net, 38.2% of the day, at roughly double the Dining Room's net per order -- that is the highest-yield seating in the building and worth protecting. Categories: Food $3,543.85 (49.4%, 237 items), Draft Beer $1,458.00 (20.3%, 186), Liquor $1,193.50 (16.6%, 96), Wine $353.00 (37), Espresso Service $309.50 (60), Bottled Beer $166.00 (28), NA Beverage $84.00 (18). Alcohol combined 44.1% of net.

SLING -- today's Sunday Aug 23 roster had not been delivered at 4:05 AM (lands ~7:00 AM PT). Most recent is SATURDAY AUG 22: 13 employees, 13 shifts, 82.25 scheduled hours, 0 uncovered, 2 off, 5.25 OVERTIME HOURS. The OT is the thing to watch -- Friday ran 10 people / 55.25 hrs / 0 OT, so Saturday hours jumped 48.9%. Mix: 4 servers (Osmar Beltran, James Hernadez, Bea Southern, Bri Kelley), 3 bartenders (Christine Vargas, Andrew Turner, Harmony Willson), 2 baristas (Julianna Ornelas, Isa Morabia), 2 bussers (Noel Nunez, Cal Carter), 1 barback (Gabriel Lopez galindo), 1 cook (Isael Salvador Narciso). One cook on the highest-volume day again. With Friday already at 22.8% labor, Saturday needs a strong net just to hold that ratio -- and we will not know until the numbers post.

REVIEWS -- BOTH PROFILES OPENED AND VERIFIED ON SCREEN THIS RUN. The Brewhouse: 4.5 stars, 527 reviews (up 1), FIVE unreplied, up from 4 yesterday and 1 on Friday. Queue: Donald Clay 1 star (botulism, day 16), John Rinaldo 1 star rating-only (~4 weeks, no text), and three 5-stars sitting unanswered -- R. Muller (NEW, ~20 hrs, entirely about coffee and fresh muffins despite landing on the restaurant listing), sergio salazar ('driving 3 hours to go back'), Betty Chambers (dog-friendly patio, drive to San Diego). Brewhouse Coffee: 5.0 stars, 5 reviews, ONE unreplied -- Geoff Lay on the Horchata Latte and the baristas, 8 days. Checked, not skipped. All six drafts written and staged; none posted.

GOOGLE ADS -- email signal only, no dashboard scrape this run. 2 report-ready emails in 24h, 0 disapprovals, 0 budget alerts. The campaign picture is carried forward from Aug 21 and is now 2 days stale: restaurant Performance Max ($58.37/day) paused on policy, 'Oldest SB Brewery on Tap' paused, 'World Cup HQ 2026' paused, only 'BHC Coffee | Search | P1 Launch' eligible, plus the unresolved backup-payment-method banner. If nothing changed, that is day 6 with the restaurant campaign dark while the coffee campaign carries the account.

YELP -- 2 emails, both consumer marketing blasts. 0 actionable inquiries. The business inbox showed 15 unread on Aug 21 and has not been re-opened since.

TRIPADVISOR -- nothing new in 24h. Last item is the Aug 20 ad-impressions promo, already logged.

RESERVATIONS -- 10 guests on the books for today across two SpotHopper bookings (5:00 PM Cassidy Pylant party of 8, 7:30 PM Angela Cacciatore party of 2), per the auto-refresh feed.

Never admit or deny causation in a public reply -- acknowledge, express concern, move it offline.
